title: feat(ridmeet): ridge-slide two-seed meet |M|=1 vars 0
science: Two-seed meeting-set test under rho3 on B_12(0) u B_12((2,0,0)): the first-meeting set is the SINGLETON {(1,0,0)} at t=3, so both arrival-speed variances are exactly 0 and the comparison against l1 is degenerate. The reported 'lex-first minimizer l1' is an alphabetical tiebreak, not a result, and the runner machine-asserts it as a PASS. Equal-arrival set is 313 sites under rho3 vs 265 under l1.
